title: Conditional κ = 0.001591968902833346: subspace16 complex with full R420 replay
body:

It changes the local profile by **16(e1 − e2 − e3 + e4)** while preserving scalar operations of the sliced word, starts, central cut, helper widths and PR548's physical owners. Strict concavity proves a lower moment for every 0 < b < 1; both rational engines verify the actual global endpoint. Global gain is computed from the complete profile, not added to an earlier κ.
